description: Dispatch an event: fires every tenant function with trigger.type event/webhook whose eventSource matches source (up to 25). The payload becomes the handler's event.payload. Returns matched/fired/failures with per-function results.

payload.description: Event payload delivered to each handler as event.payload

source.description: Event source name, e.g. "player.level-up" — must exactly match trigger.eventSource on subscribed functions

name: tau_trigger_event
